'''Coruscant City Tours''' was an organization based out of the [[Tourist Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], overseen by the [[Tourist Director]]. For the price of a ticket, a passenger could embark on a [[tour transport]] and take a famous tour of Coruscant's sites, including [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]], [[Calocour Heights]], the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Tickets were considered difficult to obtain.

[[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] had a pair of these tickets, paying 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Credits]] each for them. Unable to use them, they were sold to [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Captain Panaka]] at half price.

==Behind the scenes==
Coruscant City Tours was featured in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]], available for the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation|PlayStation]] and [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]].
